description_excerpt: Why Synopsys? At Synopsys, we’re at the heart of the innovations that change the way we work and play. Autonomous vehicles. Artificial intelligence. The cloud. 5G. These breakthroughs are shaping the future of smart technology—and they’re all powered by Synopsys software, IP, and digital design expertise. As a SoC DFT Engineer in our System Solutions Group, you won’t just be running tests; you will be the guardian of silicon reliability. You will architect and build the test infrastructures that ensure our next-generation chips perform flawlessly in the real world. You will own the DFT…
